subject: [PATCH v4 06/19] selftests/mm: stop khugepaged during the MADV_COLLAPSE cases

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Requested that the patch be trimmed to improve readability.

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch series modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c test to prevent khugepaged from interfering with MADV_COLLAPSE cases by clearing per-order controls in addition to global ones.
